web_fixture.title: Invoices v1 retirement notice - Cinderpath developers
web_fixture.snippet: Retirement of the v1 invoice endpoints, with the replacement paths and the notice date.
web_fixture.content:
# Invoices v1 retirement notice

Cinderpath developer notices, published 2026-03-02.

The v1 invoice endpoints (POST /v1/invoices and GET /v1/invoices/{id}) are
retired. This notice opens a 180-day window: for 180 days after the notice the
endpoints keep accepting requests exactly as before, and every response carries
a deprecation header. Once the window closes, a request to a v1 endpoint
returns 410 Gone with the body {"error": "endpoint_retired"}.

Replacements:

* POST /v1/invoices -> POST /v2/invoices
* GET /v1/invoices/{id} -> GET /v2/invoices/{id}

The v2 endpoints take the same request body, and webhook payloads are
unchanged.

turns.prompt: Cinderpath's invoicing client still calls the v1 invoice endpoints. Counting from the publication date on the retirement notice, for how many days do those paths remain in service? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
